title: Audio and transcription
privacy: Local processing · 128 MiB / 2 hours maximum. Private results and MP3 files kept for 30 days; temporary copies deleted after processing.
disabled: The administrator must enable the transcription service in the Manager.
anonymous: Speakers are anonymous labels, not identified people. Attribution may be imperfect.
speakersFailed: Speaker separation failed. The transcript remains available.
speakersUnavailable: Speaker separation unavailable: local diarization models are not configured.
speaker: Speaker {{number}}
updateCheckFailed: Image update detection is temporarily unavailable.
imageAvailable: A new service image is available. Replacement requires administrator validation.
servicePolicy: On-demand start · stops after 5 idle minutes · image checks continue while stopped.
entryPoint: Open an audio or video file in Mergeron and click Transcribe.
